name: HyperX keyboards (HP ids)
description: Per-LED lighting of the HyperX keyboards with HP product ids: Alloy Elite 2, Alloy Origins, Alloy Origins 60, Alloy Origins 65, Eve 1800, Origins 2 65. Same code as plugins/hyperx-keyboard (a plugin has one vendor id). Adapted from OpenRGB's HyperXKeyboardController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. Only Direct reports are sent: never brightness or other settings. The Alloy Origins Core (HP) (03F0:098F) is held back. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/hyperx-keyboard.md.
